title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 20. Deplores the actions of the EU Military Assistance Mission in support of Ukraine (EUMAM), which, to date, has trained more than 70 000 Ukrainian soldiers on EU territory, thereby pushing the EU into a third world war; opposes the new goal of training 75 000 Ukrainian soldiers by the end of winter 2024/2025; rejects the Council’s decision of 8 November 2024 to extend the mandate of the mission for two years; calls for the suspension of the financial, logistical and human resources support provided to the Ukrainian Armed Forces by EUMAM;
